metadata.corpus_basis: Penn-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Middle English, 2nd ed. (PPCME2)

constructions.name: Topicalized Adverbial V2 Inversion
constructions.description: Fronted temporal/manner adverb triggers finite verb inversion before subject.

constructions.name: Bipartite / Multipartite Negative Concord
constructions.description: Preverbal clitic 'ne' reinforced by postverbal 'nat', 'nevere', or 'no'.
frames: Ther nas no {noun} in al that {place}

constructions.name: Correlative Temporal-Causal Subordination ('Whan that ... thanne')
constructions.description: Subordinate complementizer 'that' appended to wh-/prepositional heads.

constructions.name: Scholastic Compilatio Source Attribution
constructions.description: Explicit delegation to pre-1400 auctoritas per Minnis compilatio model.
frames: As writ min auctour in his olde boke
Right as the wise clerkes han devysed
For in olde stories may ye rede
As Boece techeth in his sentence

constructions.name: Northern Regional Phonological & Morphological Shift
constructions.description: Unrounded OE /a:/ ('gaan', 'staan', 'ham'), pronoun 'ik', and '-es' verb ending.
frames: Ik sal now gaan right til that ilk place
Bi Goddes sale, naan bettre may ik wirke
Out at the kirke dore he gath anoon
